book.subject: 英语
book.edition: 人教版 PEP（三年级起点）

misconceptions.name: because 和 so 一起用
misconceptions.why: 汉语习惯说“因为……所以……”，就把 because 和 so 放进同一句。
misconceptions.move: 告诉学生 because 和 so 只能选一个：I like spring because it's warm. / It's warm, so I like spring.

misconceptions.name: 照汉语漏掉主语 it
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“因为很暖和”“下雨了”不用主语，英语句子要有主语，说天气、时间就用 it。
misconceptions.move: 每说一句先问：什么暖和？说天气、时间就用 it 当主语：it's warm、it's rainy。

misconceptions.name: 月份首字母没有大写
misconceptions.why: 汉语没有大小写，只记住了句首大写，不知道月份、星期、人名的首字母也要大写。
misconceptions.move: 让学生圈出句子里的月份、星期和名字，逐个检查首字母。

misconceptions.name: 只说月份时也用 on
misconceptions.why: 日期前用 on（on May 1st），就以为只说月份也用 on。
misconceptions.move: 画时间“金字塔”：at 钟点，on 某一天（星期、日期），in 月份、季节；只到月份就用 in。

misconceptions.name: 直接在基数词后加 th
misconceptions.why: 多数序数词是“基数词 + th”，就把 twelve、five、nine 也直接加 th，没注意要变形。
misconceptions.move: 把要变形的挑出来编成一串：one—first，two—second，three—third，five—fifth，eight—eighth，nine—ninth，twelve—twelfth。

misconceptions.name: 单说“我的”时用了 my
misconceptions.why: 汉语“我的”可以单说，英语 my 后面必须跟名词，单说要用 mine。
misconceptions.move: 对比：It's my dog. = It's mine. 问：my 后面跟了什么？mine 后面还能再跟词吗？

misconceptions.name: 把“我的”说成 me
misconceptions.why: 汉语“是我的”去掉“的”就成了“是我”，没分清 me（我）和 mine（我的）。
misconceptions.move: 列三列：I—me—mine，问：“我的”在哪一列？

misconceptions.name: 进行时漏掉 am/is/are
misconceptions.why: 觉得 eating 已经表示“正在吃”，就把前面的 are 漏了。
misconceptions.move: 进行时像两块积木：am / is / are + 动词 -ing，缺一块都不行；让学生在句子里把两块都圈出来。

misconceptions.name: 进行时动词没加 -ing
misconceptions.why: 记住了“正在”要加 are，忘了后面的动词也要变成 -ing。
misconceptions.move: 进行时像两块积木：am / is / are + 动词 -ing，让学生在句子里把两块都圈出来。

misconceptions.name: 把 its 写成 it's
misconceptions.why: Amy's、Mike's 里的 's 表示“的”，its 和 it's 读音又一样，就以为带撇号的 it's 才是“它的”。
misconceptions.move: 把 it's 换回 it is 读一遍：washing it is face 通不通？不通就用 its。

items.stem: I usually eat breakfast ____ 7:00 ____ the morning.
right: 上午、下午、晚上前用 in：in the morning。

ladder.q: 补全：I go to bed ____ 9:00.
补全：I do my homework ____ the evening.
用英语回答：When do you get up?（6:30）

items.stem: 说说你为什么喜欢春天，选出正确的一句。
options: Because it's warm, so I like spring.
I like spring because is warm.
I like spring because it's warm.
right: because 和 so 只用一个；
because 后面要有主语：because it's warm。
typical: Because it's warm, so I like spring.

ladder.q: 补全：— Why do you like winter? — ____ I like snow.
改错：Because it's hot, so I don't like summer.
用 because 说一句：我最喜欢秋天，因为天气凉爽。
ladder.a: I like autumn best because it's cool.

items.stem: 学校的郊游在三月。选出完全正确的一句。
options: The school trip is in march.
The school trip is in March.
The school trip is on March.
typical: The school trip is in march.

ladder.q: 改正书写：the sports meet is in april.
ladder.a: The sports meet is in April.

ladder.q: 补全：Tree Planting Day is ____ March 12th.
用英语回答：When is Children's Day?
ladder.a: It's in June.（也可以说 It's on June 1st.）

right: twelve 变序数词：把 ve 换成 f，再加 th：

ladder.q: 写出英文单词：1st ____　2nd ____　3rd ____
写出英文单词：5th ____　9th ____
用英语回答：When is National Day?

items.stem: — Whose dog is it? — It's ____ .（我的）
right: “我的”后面没有名词时用 mine：It's mine.
也可以说 It's my dog.，my 后面要跟名词。

ladder.q: 补全：This is my book. It's ____ .
补全：— Is that Amy's pen? — Yes, it's ____ .
用英语回答：Whose pictures are these?（是他们的）

right: “正在做”= am / is / are + 动词 -ing；
children 是复数，用 are：are eating。

ladder.q: 补全：Listen! Amy ____ (sing).
补全：— What are they doing? — They ____ (read) books.
用英语说：我们正在安静地写作业。

work: Look! The cat is washing it's face.
right: it's 是 it is，washing it is face 说不通。

ladder.q: 填 its 或 it's：The dog is sleeping in ____ house.
填 its 或 it's：____ time for lunch.
填 its 或 it's：Look at the dog! ____ playing with ____ ball.
